通过回调触发弹出式卡片的显示。.en-us: Show a popup card through a callback.

通过参数`transitionType`控制弹出式卡片显隐动画的类型。.en-us: Use `transitionType` to choose the popup card's show/hide animation.

通过参数`closeIconType`控制弹出式卡片关闭图标的类型。.en-us: Use `closeIconType` to choose the popup card's close icon type.

设置参数`draggable=True`后，可通过弹出式卡片的标题区域进行拖拽。.en-us: Set `draggable=True` to drag the popup card by its title area.

对弹出式卡片初始化显示的位置进行自定义。.en-us: Customize the initial position of the popup card.
